profile.headline: Software Engineer at NAVAIR
profile.summary: Passionate, driven individual adept at coding and circuit design as well as Information Technology maintenance and troubleshooting. Looking to take my next step in my career.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C++ · C (Programming Language) · Git · Electronics Technology · Electronic Engineering · Software Design · Electronics Hardware Design · Engineering · Sensors

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and updated embedded C++ programs as well as perform unit-level feature testing before handing off to Test engineers.

Kicked off and managed a Zynq processor baseline instrumentation project. This was done to address the need for a proprietary project baseline so projects can be built on a "fresh" foundation instead of existing projects with aging libraries and dependencies as well as the prevalent issue of needing special approval to migrate project folders from one secure space to another. I managed the Kanban board for features and provided support where possible.
positions.insights: Skills: FPGA · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Software Design · Engineering

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description: Provide document control support and lead coordination efforts between prime and sub-contractors. Provide administrative support and act as representative of company when meeting with prime contractor and other subs in certain aspects of coordination. Currently acting as Taft's representative in CAD & BIM coordination in multiple projects.

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.description:
Manage network and server environments for multiple clients
Provide on-site and remote technical support for critical client tech needs.

company.name: CITIG: Channel Islands Technology Integrators' Group, Inc.

positions.title: IT Lab Assistant
positions.description: My main responsibilities were to provide troubleshooting and education service to faculty and students in a lab of 40 PCs. I learned how to use AutoDesk and applied that knowledge to aiding others. For issues I lacked the access rights to resolve I would act as liaison to my supervisor and they would handle the issue from there.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
I was responsible for maintaining and repairing personal computers and network servers as well as updating the software on over 600 computers on the campus with a team of 5 others. I was also responsible for training new techs in using Symantec Ghost.

My biggest accomplishment here was recovering and rebuilding our old PC image server that contained over 50 hard disk images, as well as installing and setting up Symantec Ghost from scratch on a newer system. I did this on a team with another technician who acquired the newer hardware as well as software licenses while I researched improving from the old system.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description: Provide immediate service and aid to others in the Taft office as well as work with the administrator and president in updating and improving their custom database system using C++ and SQL.

projects.title: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
projects.description:
Design and build a fully autonomous (no direct human interaction) UAV to herd a number of ground robots while navigating within a 20 meter square field and avoiding moving obstacle ground robots and other competing UAVs.

This is to participate in Mission 7 of the International Aerial Robotics Competition.
